summary: Estonian authorities are investigating potential Russian involvement in a fire that broke out at a building used by defense company Milrem Robotics, according to Prime Minister Kristen Michal.

title: US to Lift Strict Anti-Terrorism Conditions on Nigerian Vessels
title_cn: 美国取消对尼日利亚船只的严格反恐条件
summary: The US is easing long-standing conditions on Nigerian vessels entering its waters, after ports in the West African nation were judged to have improved their anti-terrorism safeguards.

title: US-Iran Peace Prospects Dim as Trump Rejects Truce Extension
title_cn: 特朗普拒绝延长停战协议，美伊和平前景黯淡
summary:
The prospects for peace in the Middle East suffered a fresh setback, with President Donald Trump saying he’s not interested in extending the expiring agreement with Iran and tensions flaring anew in the Strait of Hormuz.
Wayne Sanders, Senior Defense Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discusses the latest Iran headlines and the ramp-up of American military production. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Botswana Transport Minister Noah Salakae Resigns
title_cn: 博茨瓦纳交通部长诺亚·萨拉凯辞职
summary: Botswana’s transport and infrastructure minister, Noah Salakae, tendered his resignation to lawmakers, citing a probe into alleged corruption.
